subject: a lime-plaster coastal house with an exterior blue stair
art_direction: 浅灰泥海边小屋与蓝色外阶相连，阳光、陶瓦和远处静海形成清新竖屏风景。
visible_description: 浅灰泥海边小屋与蓝色外阶相连，阳光、陶瓦和远处静海形成清新竖屏风景。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a lime-plaster coastal house with an exterior blue stair. Run the stair diagonally through the lower scene toward a small roof terrace. Keep the terrace rail plain and below the upper sky area. A thin sea band appears behind the house, with soft blue reflections on the wall. Use restrained terracotta roof detail and no signs, laundry, or people. Use clean architectural gouache. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
